name: monorepo-nodejs-serverless-template
description: A monorepo template for building Node.js serverless applications on AWS Lambda with shared packages, structured logging, JWT authentication, and OpenAPI validation.

scripts.deploy:dev: npm run build:services && cd infra && npm run deploy -- --context stage=dev
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build:services && cd infra && npm run deploy -- --context stage=staging
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run build:services && cd infra && npm run deploy -- --context stage=prod
